title: Polynomial time for the validation pipeline
statement: The following four functions on binary strings are polynomial-time computable: the function returning the one-bit word that records whether the catalog split is valid; the recovered-instance function; the function returning the one-bit word that records whether the recovered instance passes the CNF syntax test; and the safe evaluator request assembly function.
replaced:
The following four functions on binary strings are polynomial-time computable: the
single-bit split-validity test, the instance projection, the single-bit syntax scan
of the projected instance, and the safe evaluator request assembly.
